name: shell_variable_expansion
description: Write Bash variable references using brace-form parameter expansion, with variable-name copying control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 name=random.choice(['HOME','PATH','USER','SHELL','EDITOR','LANG','HOST','FILE','MODE','ROOT','PORT','TEMP']);value=random.choice(['alpha','beta','gamma','delta'])
 p=f'In Bash, variable {name} contains {value}. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write its brace-form parameter expansion, without quotes. Expansion:', 'answer':' ${'+name+'}'})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy its variable name. Name:', 'answer':' '+name})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
